rv.q: I can't believe I have fallen for a schlub with a cheesy mustache and a Star Wars shower curtain. But, hey, I'm not the only one who's succumbed to the silly charm of The Other Josh Cohen. There's a reason this zingy little musical has gone from downtown's Soho Playhouse to New Jersey's Paper Mill P...
Cleverly written by the Messrs. Rossmer and Rosen, The Other Josh Cohen is a light and lively diversion that’s probably going to keep a smile on your face for its 95-minute entirety.
